# E20b tables (generated by report.py)

HG008T absorbed truth alleles on HPRC v2.1 (d46), E5d set. Normal = HG008-N-D PacBio HiFi (GIAB BCM Revio 68x), tumor = HG008-T PacBio HiFi (116x, the reads of Pansoma's HG008T PacBio GAMs), both realigned to d46 with the GAMs' giraffe settings (vg 1.77, -b hifi). ALT path = the walked graph sequence between the read's GRCh38 anchors is the ALT hap or closer to it than to GRCh38 (path label alt / alt_like); REF read / ALT read = the read's own bases are closer to GRCh38 / to GRCh38 + truth. Spanning reads with MAPQ > 10.
